cards.name: Confounding Conundrum
cards.oracleText:
When this enchantment enters, draw a card.
Whenever a land an opponent controls enters, if that player had another land enter the battlefield under their control this turn, they return a land they control to its owner's hand.

cards.name: Painful Quandary
cards.oracleText: Whenever an opponent casts a spell, that player loses 5 life unless they discard a card.

cards.name: Living Conundrum
cards.oracleText:
Hexproof
If you would draw a card while your library has no cards in it, skip that draw instead.
As long as there are no cards in your library, this creature has base power and toughness 10/10 and has flying and vigilance.

cards.name: Perilous Predicament
cards.oracleText: Each opponent sacrifices an artifact creature and a nonartifact creature of their choice.
